scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md docs client/index.html client/src client/tailwind.config.js client/vite.config.js server/src server/tests server/scripts eslint.config.js package.json client/package.json server/package.json
